content:
[L] high | action buttons column, table rows | Open/Edit/Delete buttons stack vertically and collide, Delete buttons from adjacent rows visually merge into one solid red block with no clear row separation.
[S] high | table action column | Open/Edit/Delete buttons in each row are unevenly aligned — Edit buttons sit at a different vertical offset than Open, and Delete buttons overlap row boundaries instead of being on one shared line.
[S] high | new organization card | form fields are right-aligned at the far edge of the card while labels sit at the far left, leaving a huge dead horizontal gap and an unreadable label-to-input association across ~900px.
[S] med | new organization card vs filter bar | "Create Organization" black button bottom-left and input fields top-right create diagonal flow; inputs are not aligned with the button or any shared grid.
[H] med | table body | numbers in CUSTOMERS/CONVERSATIONS columns are rendered in a different style than the row labels and are weakly weighted, making counts read as random metadata rather than scannable data.
[H] med | domains column | domain values use a monospace/typewriter font while every other cell uses the UI sans font, mixing type treatments within one table row.
[H] med | filter bar | "Filter" button is heavy solid black with emphasis equal to primary action "Create Organization", competing bold elements for a trivial secondary control.
[C] high | bottom two-thirds of screen | large empty dead zone below the New organization card — the page content ends ~40% down and the rest of the window is blank gray.
[C] med | filter row | filter input is left-aligned and tiny while the Filter button hugs the far right edge, disconnecting paired controls across the full window width.
[C] med | header row | "3 organizations" count is stranded as floating text next to Sync now with no grouping or container, reading as debug output.
[C] low | new organization card | card spans full width for two fields, wasting enormous horizontal space while the table above is dense.
[S] low | page header | subtitle "customer organizations, their domains, and their members" is lowercase, unstyled, and spaced inconsistently from the title above it.

VERDICT: unprofessional — colliding red Delete buttons, a broken diagonal form layout, and a giant dead zone make this read as a debug prototype, not a product.
